column3: The related Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the BMARK 2026-V22 PSA is expected to be entitled to a liquidation fee determined, with respect to the applicable liquidation proceeds, at a liquidation fee rate equal to the lesser of (i) 1.00% of the related payment or proceeds (or, if such rate would result in an aggregate liquidation fee less than $25,000, then the liquidation fee rate will be equal to such higher rate as would result in an aggregate liquidation fee equal to $25,000) and (ii)$1,000,000.
